contentPattern.structure: image | heading + lead paragraph + 1 CTA button

suitableFor: mid-page image + text feature sections with a single lead image and a CTA button
two-column promo blocks with heading, body copy, and a call-to-action
notSuitableFor: article intros with byline/date meta and no CTA (use columns-article)
full-bleed hero intros with an image cluster (use columns-intro)
